items.text: Add Notch, Editorial, Glass, Cinema and Mono poster looks; the RPDB look is no longer offered among the presets
Set streaming provider icons per poster shape: on/off, maximum number of icons and region, with duplicate providers removed and Malaysia added
Set the badge overflow behaviour separately for each poster shape
Get started from a single setup wizard that now includes the first-use checklist, with a hint when language and region lists scroll
Improve readability in the light theme and make buttons easier to tap on mobile
Rotate saved posters at a fixed daily cut, with the poster cache aligned to it
Refresh cached posters whenever poster route logic changes, so stale posters no longer linger after an update
Keep the home page lighter by pausing the poster wall when it is offscreen, the tab is hidden or the layout is a single column
